'''Elshandruu City''' was located on [[Elshandruu Pica]],<ref name="Journal 8" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Bacta War">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref> situated in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> The [[City/Legends|city]] contained the [[Hotel/Legends|resort hotel]] [[Margath's on Elshandruu Pica]], which was robbed<ref name="Journal 8" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]<ref name="Date">{{JournalCite|8|Galaxywide NewsNets}} states that [[Tombat]] [[Thief/Legends|robbed]] [[Margath's on Elshandruu Pica]] on 36:9:15 and 36:9:17, which correspond to [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> by the [[galaxy|intergalactic]] jewel [[Thief/Legends|thief]] [[Tanda Marelle|Tombat]].<ref name="Journal 8" /> Two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later,<ref name="Date" /> the stolen jewels along with an additional [[quella stone]] were returned to the hotel's vault by the thief. The [[Colonial News Nets]] published a news article about the incident after the first theft and the [[NovaNetwork]] published an article after the return.<ref name="Journal 8" />

==Behind the scenes==
Elshandruu City was mentioned in two [[in-universe]] news articles included in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|eighth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]''. The articles were written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and the journal was released by [[West End Games]] in [[November]] [[1995]].<ref name="Journal 8" />
